Iowa.focus: Healthy Hometowns: hubs, workforce, cancer and co-located care
Iowa.description: Iowa's Healthy Hometowns program supports rural hospitals and partners, builds long-term collaborations, prevents and treats chronic disease, combats cancer and upgrades equipment and technology.
initiatives: Hometown Connections
Formal partnerships and hub-and-spoke Health Hubs, expanding the Governor's Centers of Excellence program, with telehealth and specialized equipment.
Best and Brightest
Recruiting and retaining the rural healthcare workforce.
Combat Cancer – Prevent and Treat
Radon testing, mammograms and breast MRI, FIT tests and colonoscopies, and skin cancer care through telehealth and new equipment.
Communities of Care
Co-location of different rural providers.

Kansas.focus: Prevention, local primary care, workforce, value-based care, data and technology
Kansas.description: Kansas plans five initiatives aimed at cutting chronic disease and avoidable hospitalizations, reducing rural hospitals with negative margins, and placing all rural Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries in accountable care relationships by 2031.
initiatives: Expand prevention programs
Incentives for evidence-based practices and a statewide Accountable Food Is Medicine program supported by community health workers.
Secure local primary care
Regional partnerships and behavioral health integrated into primary care, emergency departments and nursing facilities.
Enable value-based care
Moving rural Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries into accountable care relationships.
Harness data and technology
Data sharing, remote patient monitoring and consumer-facing technologies.

Kentucky.focus: Five care innovation models for chronic disease, maternity, crisis, dental and EMS
Kentucky.description: Kentucky, where 41.6% of residents live in rural areas, proposes five care innovation models focused on access and prevention for high-priority conditions.
initiatives: Rural Community Hubs for Chronic Care Innovation
Community-led prevention to reduce obesity and diabetes.
PoWERing Maternal and Infant Health
Telehealth-enabled teams to increase timely perinatal care in maternity care deserts.
Rapid Response to Recovery
EmPATH units, mobile crisis and telehealth for integrated crisis care.
Rooted in Health and From Crisis to Care
Rural dental access through training and mobile services, and integrated EMS and trauma response.

Louisiana.focus: Workforce, state-managed EHR, value-based care and prevention
Louisiana.description: Louisiana plans six initiatives to expand the workforce, promote technology and data sharing, and use financial incentives so its 1.1 million rural residents can get care close to home.
initiatives: Resilient rural health and emergency system
Workforce incentives, continuous training and technology-enabled care coordination.
Rural health technology
A state-managed, CMS-aligned EHR system plus a tech catalyst fund for digital tools and mobile care platforms.
Value-based payment
Payment and care models that reward outcomes.
Prevention and nutrition
Community programs addressing non-clinical factors of chronic disease.

Maine.focus: Population health, workforce, technology and affordability
Maine.description: Maine plans five initiatives for America's oldest state, tracked against four goals: better blood-pressure control, 10% fewer readmissions, less delayed care, and at least 75% of rural hospitals at or above a 1% operating margin.
initiatives: Population health
Adopting and expanding proven population health solutions.
Rural workforce
Growing the rural healthcare workforce.
Technology
Technologies that connect every community to advanced care.
Affordability and durability
Pairing affordability measures with quality, efficiency and fiscal sustainability.
